query: 用中文找 Hacker News 上把 SQLite 当作应用程序文件格式来讨论的英文帖子
answer:
Hacker News 上直接讨论「把 SQLite 当作应用程序文件格式」的英文帖，主要都指向同一篇官方说明：https://sqlite.org/appfileformat.html。下面的链接和原句都来自刚才打开的 HN 页面或 HN Algolia 索引。

## 主讨论串

1. **SQLite as an Application File Format (2014)**  
   https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=23508923  
   afiori，2020-06-13，567 分，301 条评论。外链是 https://sqlite.org/appfileformat.html。  
   TheRealPomax（https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=23510209）原句：  
   > The great thing about applications that use sqlite as their application file format is that you can write secondary apps and utilities to supplement the applications themselves.  
   > For example, Adobe's Lightroom uses sqlite as their application file format, which means that it's almost trivial to write an application to help it do things it's either really bad/exceedingly slow at [...]  
   同帖里 pvg（https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=23511467）指向更早的一次讨论：  
   > Previously: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=18754634

2. **更早的同题帖**  
   https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=18754634  
   kjeetgill，2018-12-24，211 分，161 条评论。标题同样是 “SQLite as an Application File Format (2014)”，外链 https://www.sqlite.org/appfileformat.html。

3. **2025 年再次提交**  
   https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46076642  
   gjvc，2025-11-28，178 分，99 条评论。  
   incanus77（https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46080301）原句：  
   > I did this for MBTiles, for storing (at the time, raster) map tiles at Mapbox.  
   > Bundled the tiles into SQLite (I was inspired by seeing Dr. Hipp speak at a conference) and voila, things both easy to move and to checksum.  
   out_of_protocol（https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46083208）原句：  
   > Also, tested .zip vs .tar vs sqlite vs file system. Of this bunch, sqlite was the most compact format with minimal overhead.

4. **评论里把这件事称为 killer feature**  
   https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=40655974  
   这不是独立故事，而是 OskarS 在 2024-06-12 写在父帖 https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=40654734（Discussion on why SQLite is gaining popularity）下的评论。原句：  
   > The killer feature for me with SQLite is as an application file format: https://sqlite.org/appfileformat.html  
   > One notable application that uses SQLite for this is Audacity: all the stuff you record is streamed into a SQLite database (the project file).  
   boffinAudio（https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=40656327）原句：  
   > I used SQLite as the file format for a game system, and it was probably one of the most successful technical decisions I've made in 40 years.

5. **Ask HN: Has Anyone Used SQLite as an Application File Format?**  
   https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=28113093  
   ghoward，2021-08-09，4 分，2 条评论。提问原句：  
   > I am considering using SQLite as an application file format, for many reasons, of which the first is "free" ACID semantics.

## 同一主题的案例讨论

**What If OpenDocument Used SQLite?**  
https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45132498  
whatisabcdefgh，2025-09-04，279 分，105 条评论。外链是官方案例 https://www.sqlite.org/affcase1.html。  
agwa（https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45134010）原句：  
> If you're going to use SQLite as an application file format, you should:  
> 1. Enable the secure_delete pragma [...] so that when your user deletes something, the data is actually erased.

## 顺带提到这个用法的评论

- kortex，https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=31326930，父帖 https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=31318708：  
  > That seems exactly opposite to the growing trend of "sqlite-as-application-file-format".
- srcreigh，https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=31156251，父帖 https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=31152490：  
  > Considering adobe Photoshop use(d) SQLite for application file format, this could be very far from unusual.

同题但几乎没有讨论的重复提交还有 https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=10308691（2015，12 分，0 评论）和 https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=8201992（2014，标题是 “SQLite as an application file format”，指向一场 EuroTcl 演讲，1 分，0 评论）。分数和评论数是这次抓取时的快照。
